title: SessionCompacted
description: The conversation was compacted: what came before is now a summary the agent carries forward. Said on its own rather than as a status, because a client that keeps the turns on screen has to mark the point — and the context meter drops there.

trigger.description: `manual` — somebody sent `/compact`; `auto` — the context was full and the agent compacted it.

preTokens.description: How many tokens the context held before, when the engine says.

compactionId.description: Stable live and in the history — what lets a client tell two compactions of the same conversation apart (plan 27, F3 · B-09). Absent on a server older than it.
